criteria.reason: Reconciles S1-01 through S1-15 against observed M78 artifacts and separates functional candidate coverage from method/source release, customer evidence, legal applicability, operations and assurance gates.

Defines M79 as the smallest next executable milestone with bounded profiles, accountable handoffs, eight observable acceptance criteria and fail-closed outcomes. Candidate2 removes routine board-feedback waits from sequencing while retaining demonstrations and meaningful updates.
Defines the remaining path through a real customer inventory and qualified human handoff, preserves the initial profile, and separates the few board/customer-dependent decisions from autonomous work.
Records the bounded live application/schema observation and small latency sample without turning it into a performance or release claim; representative operational acceptance remains explicit.

notes: CPO planning only. No code, host, database, Git, provider, shared ledger or external request changes.
No subagents spawned. Root remains sole writer for product release, Git, provider and shared operations.

Candidate1 is preserved unchanged. Independent first review failed on a material sequencing conflict: routine board feedback was incorrectly made a blocking dependency despite standing authorization for sequential bounded Scope1 work.
Candidate2 removes routine feedback waits, retains demonstrations and meaningful progress updates, and corrects the live-state wording.

Independent targeted re-review accepted exact Candidate2 and resolved PLAN-R01/R02. The first-review failure and one rework cycle remain preserved. This planning acceptance does not approve methods, rights, legal applicability, customer evidence or assurance.
Requested Sol/medium; observed model and effort unavailable and retained as unknown.
